layout_and_components.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy (2-3x default Tailwind spacing: p-8, py-16, py-24). Containers with borders must maintain inner padding to prevent text collision.
layout_and_components.bento_grid: Mode A: Tetris Grid (12-column layout with mixed spans: 8-col hero visual, 4-col stat card, 6-col service module).
layout_and_components.hero_overlay: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40 or bg-gradient-to-r from-navy-950/80 via-navy-900/40 to-transparent for legible text over rich corporate photography.
layout_and_components.cards: Subtle border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), backdrop-blur-md, soft ambient shadow, 1px hover stroke highlight.
layout_and_components.testing_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='service-card-iso27001').

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll enabled for editorial weight
motion.animations: Framer Motion staggered entrance for grid items, smooth opacity + Y translation (duration: 0.4s, ease: 'easeOut')
motion.micro_interactions: Hover scale on buttons (scale-102), active press feedback, glowing border shimmer on primary CTAs

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text, 3:1 for large headers

instructions_to_main_agent: Incorporate the provided image URLs cleanly into the site components: Hero side visual, About page consulting meetings, Services Bento Grid cards, Audience section accordions, Full-bleed statement strip banner, and Why-Us dark grid section.
Ensure image cards feature subtle 1px borders, smooth aspect ratios (aspect-[16/9] or aspect-[4/3]), lazy loading, and fallbacks.
Keep typography crisp: Outfit for bold headlines, Inter for readable body text, JetBrains Mono for overlines and data badges.
Ensure all buttons, interactive items, tabs, accordions, and images carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App text-align center is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons—use Phosphor Icons, Lucide, or Radix icons.
Micro-animations on every interaction - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
